scenes.about: A pen stroke, a mouse stroke and a highlighter stroke in each of the six colours.
scenes.name: stroke-every-colour

scenes.about: Pen (left) and mouse (right) strokes at size 2.
scenes.name: stroke-size-2

scenes.about: Pen (left) and mouse (right) strokes at size 4.
scenes.name: stroke-size-4

scenes.about: Pen (left) and mouse (right) strokes at size 8.
scenes.name: stroke-size-8

scenes.about: Highlighters (translucent, no pressure) of sizes 2, 4 and 8 beside pens, crossing a pen line.
scenes.name: stroke-highlighter-on-and-off

scenes.about: Constant pressure: 0.5 (a mouse, which simulates pressure) and other values (taken as sent).
scenes.name: stroke-pressure-constant

scenes.about: Pen strokes whose pressure rises and falls, and one that ramps from 0.05 to 1.
scenes.name: stroke-pressure-varying

scenes.about: A stroke of one point (a dot) at each size, as a highlighter, with pressure 0.9, and a stroke of two identical points.
scenes.name: stroke-one-point-dot

scenes.about: Strokes of two points, which are straight segments with round ends.
scenes.name: stroke-two-points

scenes.about: A single stroke of 1,200 points, the most the client keeps.
scenes.name: stroke-1200-points

scenes.about: Strokes that cross themselves: a figure of loops with a pen, a translucent highlighter over it, and a spiral.
scenes.name: stroke-self-crossing-scribble

scenes.about: Few points far apart (60 to 95 px), as a fast flick of the pen is sampled.
scenes.name: stroke-very-fast-sampling

scenes.about: Hundreds of points a fraction of a pixel apart (a slow hand on a fine pen), many of them equal after rounding.
scenes.name: stroke-very-slow-sampling

scenes.about: Pressure that a device should not send (0, negative, above 1) is taken as sent, constant (left) or alternating with 0.5 (right).
scenes.name: stroke-pressure-out-of-range

scenes.about: Only `true` makes a highlighter: the string "true", 1, false and null draw pens (the rows are, from the top, true, "true", 1, false, null).
scenes.name: stroke-highlighter-flag-must-be-true

scenes.about: A line at sizes 2, 4 and 8 drawn right/down, left/down, right/up and left/up (x2 < x1, y2 < y1).
scenes.name: shape-line-every-size-and-direction

scenes.about: A arrow at sizes 2, 4 and 8 drawn right/down, left/down, right/up and left/up (x2 < x1, y2 < y1).
scenes.name: shape-arrow-every-size-and-direction

scenes.about: A rect at sizes 2, 4 and 8 drawn right/down, left/down, right/up and left/up (x2 < x1, y2 < y1).
scenes.name: shape-rect-every-size-and-direction

scenes.about: A ellipse at sizes 2, 4 and 8 drawn right/down, left/down, right/up and left/up (x2 < x1, y2 < y1).
scenes.name: shape-ellipse-every-size-and-direction

scenes.about: Each shape with both ends at one point: a dot where round caps give one, nothing where they do not.
scenes.name: shape-zero-size

scenes.about: Each shape one pixel wide and high, one pixel wide only, and one pixel high only.
scenes.name: shape-one-pixel

scenes.about: Small rectangles (2 to 64 px) where the corner radius is a quarter of the shorter side, not 8.
scenes.name: shape-rect-tiny

scenes.about: Large rectangles, where the corner radius is the 8 px cap, and one where one side is short.
scenes.name: shape-rect-huge

scenes.about: Arrows from 0 to 120 px long: the head is at least 12 px (3.5 times the size when that is more), however short the shaft.
scenes.name: shape-arrow-short

scenes.about: One line and three lines of text at each of the three sizes.
scenes.name: text-sizes-20-28-40

scenes.about: Lines of text with empty lines at the start, the middle and the end, spaces, tabs, a carriage return and a form feed (canvas text takes the last three for spaces).
scenes.name: text-multiline-empty-lines

scenes.about: Lines of 2,000 characters (and one of 2,100, cut to the 2,000 the board keeps): a very wide box, so the camera is at its smallest zoom.
scenes.name: text-2000-character-line

scenes.about: Text in each of the six colours.
scenes.name: text-every-colour

scenes.about: Every Vietnamese vowel with every tone mark, in lower and upper case, and a sentence.
scenes.name: text-vietnamese-all-tone-marks

scenes.about: Vietnamese typed as base letters plus a combining tone mark the fonts have (U+0300, 0301, 0303, 0309, 0323), next to the same words precomposed. Marks the fonts lack (the circumflex, the horn) are not in the board's fonts, so a browser would take them from a system font: not a case the board can match.
scenes.name: text-vietnamese-combining-marks

scenes.about: Every superscript and subscript character `typeset.ts` produces, and formulas that use them.
scenes.name: text-typeset-superscripts-subscripts

scenes.about: Every Greek letter `typeset.ts` produces, at three sizes.
scenes.name: text-typeset-greek

scenes.about: Every operator, relation, set and logic symbol `typeset.ts` produces.
scenes.name: text-typeset-operators-sets-logic

scenes.about: Every arrow `typeset.ts` produces.
scenes.name: text-typeset-arrows

scenes.about: The superscript capitals (ᴬᴮᴰ...) that only Noto Sans has, beside Inter text.
scenes.name: text-typeset-superscript-capitals

scenes.about: Geometric shapes, dingbats and miscellaneous symbols that only Noto Sans Symbols 2 has.
scenes.name: text-symbols-noto-sans-symbols-2

scenes.about: Lines that use Inter, Noto Sans, Noto Sans Math and Noto Sans Symbols 2 in one line, at three sizes.
scenes.name: text-lines-mixing-all-four-fonts

scenes.about: Latin punctuation, quotes, dashes, currency and digits.
scenes.name: text-punctuation-and-currency

scenes.about: Sizes the tools never send but the format allows: fractional, small, large, and one over 200 (drawn as 200).
scenes.name: text-odd-sizes

scenes.about: A blank sheet with ink on it: white paper, a pale edge, the board's dot grid around it.
scenes.name: sheet-blank

scenes.about: A landscape picture (16:9) on a 16:9 sheet.
scenes.name: sheet-deck-landscape

scenes.about: A portrait picture centred on a landscape sheet, with white at the sides.
scenes.name: sheet-deck-portrait

scenes.about: A square picture on a wide sheet, fitted to its height.
scenes.name: sheet-deck-square

scenes.about: The ring a sheet shows while its picture is still on its way (the frame is taken before it arrives).
scenes.name: sheet-picture-loading

scenes.about: The crossed frame a sheet shows when its picture cannot be had (the deck has no such page).
scenes.name: sheet-picture-failed

scenes.about: Three sheets: the camera shows all of them until the teacher's view names one, then follows the view from sheet to sheet, and falls back when it names a sheet that is not there.
scenes.name: sheets-view-switching

scenes.about: The smallest zoom: the grid is hidden (steps under 12 px), a sheet's edge is 7.5 px wide.
scenes.name: viewport-zoom-0-2

scenes.about: Half size: the grid is back, the edge is 3 px.
scenes.name: viewport-zoom-0-5

scenes.about: Scale 1.
scenes.name: viewport-zoom-1

scenes.about: A fractional zoom, with the dot size taken from it.
scenes.name: viewport-zoom-1-37

scenes.about: Twice the size: the board's strokes and text are scaled by the camera, not redrawn at another size.
scenes.name: viewport-zoom-2

scenes.about: The largest zoom, close on the heading.
scenes.name: viewport-zoom-5

scenes.about: A camera at fractional board coordinates, zoom 1: the dot grid and every element sit on fractions of a pixel.
scenes.name: viewport-fractional-pan

scenes.about: A fractional pan and zoom together.
scenes.name: viewport-fractional-pan-and-zoom

scenes.about: A camera left of and above the board, so the board is at the bottom right.
scenes.name: viewport-negative-pan

scenes.about: Zoom 0.36: the grid step is 11.52 px, under 12, so no dots.
scenes.name: viewport-grid-hidden-under-12-px

scenes.about: Zoom 0.375: the grid step is exactly 12 px, so the dots are drawn (with the 0.8 px minimum dot).
scenes.name: viewport-grid-shown-at-12-px

scenes.about: A camera far from the origin, where the dot grid's offset wraps around the step.
scenes.name: viewport-grid-offset-wraps

scenes.about: Elements that start just outside the stage and reach into it (and ones that only touch it): none may be dropped as off screen while a pixel of it shows.
scenes.name: viewport-culling-elements-crossing-the-edge

scenes.about: No camera given: content larger than the stage is fitted with its margin, zoom under 1.
scenes.name: viewport-fit-wide-content

scenes.about: No camera given: small content is centred at zoom 1 (never zoomed in).
scenes.name: viewport-fit-small-content

scenes.about: No camera given: content of no width or height (one unit counts).
scenes.name: viewport-fit-single-point

scenes.about: No camera given and nothing drawn: scale 1 at the origin, only the grid.
scenes.name: viewport-fit-empty-board

scenes.about: A deleted element (a tombstone of a higher version) is gone.
scenes.name: rules-deleted-element

scenes.about: A write older than the deletion that arrives later does not bring the element back.
scenes.name: rules-tombstone-blocks-late-older-write

scenes.about: A later write of a higher version replaces the element; an older version arriving after it is ignored.
scenes.name: rules-higher-version-wins

scenes.about: Two writes of one version: the one with the lower nonce wins, whatever order they arrive in.
scenes.name: rules-same-version-lower-nonce-wins

scenes.about: The board is cleared, then drawn on again; a clear drops writes that were pending in the same step.
scenes.name: rules-clear-then-draw-again

scenes.about: The lock only changes what students may do: the picture is the same before and after.
scenes.name: rules-lock-changes-nothing-drawn

scenes.about: A snapshot part-way through the log merges into the board (it does not replace it); one older than what is there changes nothing.
scenes.name: rules-snapshot-mid-log

scenes.about: Overlapping elements are drawn by z, and elements of one z by id; an element written later with a lower z lies below.
scenes.name: rules-stacking-order-by-z-then-id

scenes.about: Elements the board refuses: an unknown colour, a size of 0, a stroke with a stray coordinate, empty text, a sheet that is too small, a half-named deck page. Only the good ones are drawn.
scenes.name: rules-invalid-elements-are-dropped

scenes.about: A size over 200 is drawn as 200.
scenes.name: rules-size-capped-at-200

scenes.about: Records of the lesson's quiz game are in the log and the board ignores them.
scenes.name: rules-quiz-records-are-skipped

scenes.about: One renderer and replay draw 60 s, then 10 s, then 40 s, then 5 s and 60.5 s: each frame must equal one drawn from a fresh replay (here, the web player's).
scenes.name: rules-seeking-backwards

scenes.about: A stroke someone is drawing, growing as updates add points; then their finished element replaces the preview.
scenes.name: presence-stroke-growing-then-finished

scenes.about: Updates that do not follow on: points from the middle of a stroke continue what is shown, a new stroke number starts again.
scenes.name: presence-stroke-update-resumed-mid-way

scenes.about: Previews of a rectangle, an ellipse (drawn backwards), an arrow and some text, each by a different person.
scenes.name: presence-shape-and-text-previews

scenes.about: Two people drawing at the same time (a stroke and a rectangle); the first then starts a highlighter stroke, which replaces her first preview but keeps her place in the order.
scenes.name: presence-two-people-at-once

scenes.about: A person's elements record clears their own preview only: the rectangle's owner is done, the stroke's owner is still drawing, and the teacher's write clears neither.
scenes.name: presence-preview-cleared-by-that-users-elements-record

scenes.about: A preview is shown for 6 s after the person's last update, then dropped: the stroke at 7.9 s and gone at 8.1 s; the rectangle (sent at 6 s) outlives it.
scenes.name: presence-expires-after-the-6-second-ttl

scenes.about: Pointers and the names that come with them are not part of the video: only the line preview is drawn.
scenes.name: presence-cursors-and-names-are-not-drawn

scenes.about: A preview that is a sheet, the view or a malformed stroke draws nothing.
scenes.name: presence-sheet-view-and-malformed-previews-are-ignored

scenes.about: A preview that edits an element by reference. The board patches only graphs, solids and symbols (pack elements, which neither renderer draws yet): for a rectangle or an unknown id nothing is drawn and the element stays where it is.
scenes.name: presence-ref-preview-moving-an-existing-element

scenes.name: stage-viewport-content-624

scenes.name: stage-viewport-content-664

scenes.name: stage-stage-free-board-624

scenes.about: 1280x664, the stage without it: an unbounded board of ink and text.
scenes.name: stage-stage-free-board-664

scenes.about: About 800 strokes, shapes and text lines (Vietnamese, maths, symbols) over three sheets, then 40 more strokes, 30 deletions and a preview.
scenes.name: dense-800-elements-of-every-kind
